lines: Jaate-jaate woh mujhe achchhi nishaani de gaya
couplets.en: As he left, he gave me a keepsake.

lines: Umr bhar doharaaoonga, aisi kahaani de gaya
couplets.en: He left me a story I will tell all my life.

lines: Us se main kuchh paa sakoon, aisi kahaan ummeed thi
couplets.en: How could I have hoped for anything from him?

lines: Gham bhi woh shaayad baraaye meharbaani de gaya
couplets.en: Perhaps even the sorrow was a kindness.

lines: Sab hawaayen le gaya mere samandar ki koi
couplets.en: Someone took every wind from my sea.

lines: Aur mujhko ek kashti baadbaani de gaya
couplets.en: And he left me a boat with a sail.

lines: Jaate-jaate woh mujhe achchhi nishaani de gaya

lines: Khair, main pyaasa raha, par usne itna to kiya
couplets.en: I stayed thirsty, though he did this much for me.
Still, he did this much for me.

lines: Meri palkon ki kataaron ko woh paani de gaya
couplets.en: He left my lashes wet with tears.
Such was the story he left me.
